 Advertisment Indian Markets 6 Stocks With Order Books Up to 875% Higher Than Their Market Cap to keep an eye on
 Stocks with order books exceeding their market capitalisations offer strong project visibility and revenue potential. Explore six infrastructure and construction stocks whose order books range from 1.48 to 9.75 times their market caps.
 by Sridhar J by Sridhar J 
 10 Nov 2026 15:01 IST
 Link copied! Copy failed! A strong order book provides companies with healthy revenue visibility for the coming years. It supports consistent project execution, enables expansion into new markets, and strengthens financial stability, creating a foundation for sustainable growth and improving investor confidence. 
 Advertisment Several companies across the infrastructure, construction, and water treatment sectors are backed by robust order books that exceed their respective market capitalisations, indicating strong business visibility. Here are five stocks whose order books are higher than their market capitalisations. 
 Also Read: How Medical Tourism Could Become the Next Major Upswing for Max Healthcare 
 Larsen & Toubro Ltd 
 Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a leading Indian multinational engaged in engineering, procurement and construction (EPC), infrastructure development, manufacturing and technology services. Its business operations span transportation infrastructure, buildings, power, heavy engineering, defence, hydrocarbon, and IT services. The company executes large-scale projects across India and international markets. 
 Advertisment With a market capitalization of Rs. 5,75,821 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 8,53,500 crore, which is approximately 1.48 times its market capitalization, highlighting strong project visibility. 
 NBCC (India) Ltd 
 NBCC (India) Ltd is a government-owned company operating in the construction and infrastructure development sector. Its business activities are primarily divided into project management consultancy, engineering, procurement and construction, and real estate development. The company undertakes projects involving government buildings, residential complexes, commercial spaces, redevelopment, and infrastructure development across India. 
 With a market capitalization of Rs. 21,708 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 1,26,181 crore, which is approximately 5.81 times its market capitalization, indicating a strong pipeline of projects. 
 Advertisment NCC Ltd 
 NCC Ltd is an Indian construction and infrastructure development company engaged in executing projects across various sectors. Its business operations include buildings, transportation infrastructure, water and environment, irrigation, electrical, mining and railways. The company undertakes infrastructure projects for government agencies, public sector enterprises and private sector clients. 
 With a market capitalization of Rs. 8,220 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 80,167 crore, which is approximately 9.75 times its market capitalization, reflecting healthy project visibility.

 Advertisment Power Mech Projects Ltd 
 Power Mech Projects Ltd is an engineering and infrastructure services company primarily serving the power sector. Its key business activities include erection, testing and commissioning of power plants, operation and maintenance services, civil construction and infrastructure development. The company also undertakes projects in railways, oil and gas, steel, and other industrial sectors. 
 With a market capitalization of Rs. 7,608 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 56,647 crore, which is approximately 7.45 times its market capitalization, highlighting a strong pipeline of projects. 
 Afcons Infrastructure Ltd 
 Afcons Infrastructure Ltd is an engineering and construction company with expertise in executing complex infrastructure projects. Its business operations cover marine and industrial infrastructure, surface transport, urban infrastructure, hydro and underground projects, and oil and gas. The company has undertaken projects in India and several international markets. 
 With a market capitalization of Rs. 7,874 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 43,837 crore, which is approximately 5.57 times its market capitalization, indicating strong revenue visibility. 
 PSP Projects Ltd 
 PSP Projects Ltd is an Indian engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company engaged in providing construction and allied services across industrial, institutional, government, commercial and residential projects. Its operations cover planning, designing, civil construction, mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) services, interior fit-outs and post-construction activities. The company also provides precast construction solutions and undertakes projects across India.

 With a market capitalization of Rs. 3,098 crore, the company has an order book of Rs. 12,872 crore, which is approximately 4.16 times its market capitalization, reflecting a healthy project pipeline.
